_note: THE MILITARY FAMILY, 6 OF ~10: THE QUARTERMASTER.
The occupiers' quartermaster has been selling stolen stock back to the people it was stolen from. Take her, and take
her ledger, which is the proof the client needs. The verb is TAKE, off the woman herself. Pods come for the ledger.
Written to the delve marker set (outside entrance, centre, item markers, boss, wounded) on his ruling, so the
lint pool is EMPTY on military sites until the markers are on them (missionboard06a's note says why).
Every word holds at any military site: nothing names the site, the faction or the weather; everything the lines
point at is placed. Pay: med, capped.

place._theme: Military sites; the family's marker set.

prose.name: Bounty: The Quartermaster on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The quartermaster at the <Place> has been selling stolen stock back to the people it was taken from. Her ledger proves it.
prose.card: Local Contract. The quartermaster at the <Place> on <Planet> is wanted. Bring her ledger. Payment on contract completion.

beats.journal: The quartermaster at the <Place> is dead. I need to find her ledger.
say: That's her down. Now the ledger, because without it nothing sticks.

beats.journal: The quartermaster wrote down where every crate came from, and who she sold it to. Mostly the same people. I've got the ledger, and now I need to get it out of the <Place>.
beats.name: Quartermaster's Footlocker

message.title: Quartermaster's Ledger
message.text: Every sale in a neat hand. Beside each crate, a second column: where it came from. In most rows it is the buyer's own name.

beats.objective: Get the ledger out of the <Place>
beats.journal: I took the quartermaster down and got her ledger out of the <Place>, through the help she'd called.
say: You're out with the ledger, so it's done. A lot of people paid for their own stock, and now they can prove it.

broadcast: You're at the site. The quartermaster's there, and so's her ledger. I want her stopped and the ledger brought out. She'll call for help when it starts, she always does.
_speech: On a board the broadcast waits for him at the site. Not yet heard in game; his ear decides. No names, places, factions or currency in a voiced line.
